text:
maya: Quick sync — evidence onboarding for SOC2. Want to shift-left owners so we don't bottleneck at the end. Short ask: who can own audit-log ingestion acceptance criteria and retention proof? cc @eng-infra @eng-sre

alex: I can take audit-log ingestion acceptance (schema + pipeline). Need list of events and retention TTLs.

sam: I can do retention proof + retention policy doc. What's the desired retention? 365 or 730 days?

maya: Current ask from audit: 1 year for prod logs, 3 years for encrypted KMS access logs. Need confirmation. @jen any compliance input?

jen: Confirmed: SOC2 expects 12 months minimal for general logs; KMS/HSM key access/rotation evidence is typically held longer (we'll aim for 3 yrs). I'll add this to the control mapping. Also we need owners for non-prod evidence. @alex can you add a test plan?

alex: Will add test plan + small script to pull sample evidence. Snippet: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/logs?service=ingest > sample.json
```

tess-bot: Reminder: SOC2 milestone 'evidence intake' due in 14 days. Status: at-risk if >40% evidence outstanding.

maya: Dependency callouts: eng-infra for retention config, eng-sre for enforcement, security for KMS attestation doc. Proposed owners: audit-ingest: alex; retention-doc: sam; kms-attest: jen; evidence-runbooks: maya. Feedback?

sam: Fine, but we need eng-infra to confirm TTL config in staging before we mark retention-proof done. @eng-infra pinged.

infra-bot: eng-infra ping: retention flag deployed to staging yesterday; will promote to prod on Tue pending one more review.

alex: I'll queue the PR for pipeline tests and tag reviewers @eng-sre @eng-infra.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll draft the KMS attestation skeleton and drop the doc here (ETA EOD tomorrow).

maya: Action items recap: alex -> PR + tests; sam -> retention doc + proof templates; jen -> KMS attestation; eng-infra -> prod TTL toggle. I'll run an evidence intake check on Friday and call out any gaps. Thanks everyone :heart:

maya: If anyone needs merges prioritized, drop a :zap: reaction or DM me.
